title: the Reinado Internacional del Café 2017, held in Manizales
text: Reinado Internacional del Café 2017 beauty pageant, was held in Manizales, Colombia, on January 7, 2017. At the end of the event, the outgoing queen Maydeliana Díaz, Reina Internacional del Café 2016 from Venezuela crowned Marilú Acevedo from Mexico as her successor.
